failure_modes.name: Missing_Evidence_Not_Specified
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 1 states 'Missing critical evidence documents needed for verification: 1. Information about The Who's fourth studio album (title and track listing) 2. Biographical/discography information about The Who 3. Documentation of the specific song's chart performance on UK Singles Chart and Billboard Hot 100' — this lists broad categories but never names the specific missing entity (the actual song title or album name being referenced). The claim references 'the song' and 'Overture (The Who Song)' but the summary does not identify which specific Who song is the subject of the claim.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Query at hop 2: 'What is The Who's fourth studio album and which song on that album appears alongside "Overture (The Who Song)" and charted at top 10 on UK charts and No. 19 on Billboard Hot 100?' — This is a natural-language compound question bundling multiple targets (album name, song name, chart positions) into a single yes/no question form that retrievers struggle to process effectively.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Query at hop 2: 'What is The Who's fourth studio album and which song on that album appears alongside "Overture (The Who Song)" and charted at top 10 on UK charts and No. 19 on Billboard Hot 100?' Query at hop 3 (truncated but visible in reasoning): uses nearly identical wording asking about The Who's fourth studio album. Both queries ask the same bundled question without advancing based on retrieval results, and neither hop 2 nor hop 3 returns any documents about The Who, indicating the queries are fetching equivalent (unhelpful) results.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: (i) Summary 1 names the missing entity: 'The claim references a specific song by The Who that appears on the band's fourth studio album alongside "Overture (The Who Song)"' and lists 'Information about The Who's fourth studio album'. (ii) Query at hop 2 targets it: 'What is The Who's fourth studio album and which song on that album appears alongside "Overture (The Who Song)"'. Despite this, no passages about The Who appear in any of the three hops, indicating a corpus/retriever coverage gap.
